replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics is not my favorite subject. I find it difficult and often struggle with concepts, especially since my vocational training focused more on practical skills. I prefer literature and physics, which seem more intuitive to me.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, math often makes me anxious. The abstract concepts and complex formulas overwhelm me, and I worry about making mistakes. This anxiety is higher when facing algebra or advanced topics.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I tried using an AI tutoring app last semester, but it didn’t help much. The explanations were too technical, and I still felt lost. It made me realize I need more personalized human support.
replies.How would you explain, step by step, how: First, identify the equation like ax² + bx + c = 0. Calculate the discriminant (b²-4ac). If positive, use the quadratic formula: x = [-b ± √(b²-4ac)]/(2a). If zero, one solution; if negative, no real solutions.

Find the derivative f'(x). Set it equal to zero and solve for x. These x-values are critical points. To determine if they’re maxima/minima, use the second derivative test: f''(x) > 0 for minima, < 0 for maxima.
